maria: quick check — after yesterday's kernel perf patch i'm seeing ~+35ms on p95 for the /chat route under heavy tail. canary looked fine during normal traffic but when kv miss-rate rises we spike. anyone else see this?

kevin: saw it on canary-3 this morning. correlates with batch formation when kv hit-rate < 0.5. attaching quick profiling snippet i dumped:```
batcher.avg_batch_count=17.9
batcher.avg_tokens_per_batch=136
kernel.matmul_gemm=19.1ms (was 12.4ms)
kv_cache.local_miss_rate=0.43
queue.wait_time_p95=28ms
```

ashish: fwiw i rolled a token_budget tweak into canary for the gold tier last night (opt-in): set per-request token_budget_multiplier=0.8. trying to keep smaller requests from forming big tail batches. config snippet:```json
{"token_budget_multiplier": {"gold": 0.8, "standard": 0.6, "free": 0.45}, "queue_policy": "late_cutoff_head"}
```

jun: question — could this be kernel selection fallback overhead? if batch shapes change mid-window the runtime might pick a generic kernel that has higher setup time. we should enable kernel-selection debug for canary-3 for 1h: `--kernel-log=selection,latency` and capture traces.

olga: ran microbench on q8 kernels last night. interesting results: for batch_size >=16 quantized path wins; for <=8 overhead kills it. summary:```
# batch <=8 -> q8 median 6.2ms vs fp16 5.1ms (setup overhead)
# batch 16..32 -> q8 median 9.8ms vs fp16 13.2ms (wins)
# kv-miss pattern -> more small batches -> q8 loses
```

kevin: that matches my canary traces — when kv miss is high we get more short sequences joined and kernel picks q8 (because model variant is quantized) but batch shapes are small so overhead dominates. solution ideas: (1) dynamic token budget per route/tier (increase budget for routes with high kv-miss so batches aggregate more), (2) add fast-path kernel for tiny batches, (3) change queue_policy to favor earlier aggregation for small sequences.

maria: i'd prefer starting with (1) + (canary-only) policy change. dynamic token budget idea: compute moving p95 and kv_hit_rate per route and pick multiplier. propose heuristics:```
if kv_miss_rate > 0.35 and p95 > target_ms: token_budget_multiplier += 0.15
else decay multiplier toward baseline by 0.05 per minute
```

ashish: wrote a prototype in runtime-config service. sample rollout plan: canary on /chat (gold+standard) for 2 hours -> monitor p95, tail QPS, kernel selection ratio. experiment id: exp_latency_sculptor_0429. health gates: p95_change <= +15ms vs baseline and no increase in error-rate.

perf-bot: [automated] experiment exp_latency_sculptor_0429 started on canary-3 at 1945679200. metrics stream: https://perf.redwood.local/exp/exp_latency_sculptor_0429

jun: action items: @kevin enable kernel logging for canary-3 for the next 1h; @ashish enable the dynamic-budget prototype for gold+standard on /chat canary; @olga run focused microbench of tiny-batch kernel (<=8) and paste numbers. rollback rule: if p95 > baseline +20ms for 5m -> auto-rollback.

maria: thanks. i'll watch the dashboard and call rollback if we breach. :eyes: keep updates here.
